metadata.scope: Two additionally authorized existing raw/Hysteria2 combined-download controls after the preserved six-cell released/pruned comparison; bounded context, not changed impairment or a release ranking.
metadata.runner: ./.tmp/reflection/run.py unchanged; same existing bulk-interactive download probe,40s active and85s observation guard; no browser or new harness.

versions.raw: Owned Linux server TCP congestion_control=bbr (sysctl observed); kernel/native TCP, no MPP.
versions.h2: Existing ./.tmp/reflection/bin/hysteria v2.10.0, release build2026-07-13, commitf2ad1de5da52a1da9622285a1d61553ddaa41f21, quic-go v0.60.1-0.20260618182935-599b15a1fa26.

metadata.h2_prior: Unchanged h2-client.yaml explicitly configures500Mbps upload and download. MPP release/pruned have no configured initial-rate prior. This asymmetry is disclosed, not silently normalized.
metadata.reset_and_exclusivity: After six-cell artifact was saved, root explicitly authorized only raw then H2. Each existing run initializes router HTB/netem and all normal epochs; no no-loss/jitter/QoS/outage/return-rate override, no compile/other lab overlap.
metadata.measurement: Full original probes include untrimmed/trimmed one-second payload-receipt series, all echo attempts, exact max-gap windows and byte counters. Every raw service sample is projected with actual epoch/outage timestamps, router HTB classes/qdiscs and process rows. Raw/H2 do not expose MPP management; these fields remain null/empty, not fabricated zero metrics.
metadata.phase_summary: Nominal probe-clock intervals are preQoS0–15,QoS15–25,recovery25–30,UDPoutage30–33,postoutage33–40s. Phase p95 uses nearest-rank successful samples only. Actual shaper timestamps and entire curves are retained separately. Router peak backlog is observed netem queue occupancy, not exact bytes ahead of the tested logical frontier; no duplicate sum of the HTB and netem representations is taken.
metadata.result: Raw4.138Mbps,0.4066s maxclosedgap,80/80echo successes. H28.371Mbps,21.51495s closedgap4.64153→26.15648s,30echo successes, one actual timeout15.01271→18.01365s followed44unavailable slots. Both runners settle normally near41s with no85s censor. H2's longest gap starts before the15sQoSstep, so it cannot be attributed wholly to that step.
metadata.mpp_context: Previously preserved prunedQUIC95.238Mbps/maxgap4.922s and mixed93.139Mbps/maxgap3.888s move much more data in this profile realization. QUIC's echo timeout occurs during scheduledUDPoutage; mixed's duringQoS. Their higher delivered work can also create more queueing. Baselines do not prove every MPPgap avoidable, nor justify universal low latency or removing legitimate3soutage from interpretation.
metadata.limits: Single random realization per system; configured per-packet jitter can cause deep reordering and is not interchangeable with every real Internet ping-jitter description. Offload behavior/per-wire-packet loss equivalence remains unverified. Full-link UDPblocking forbids uninterrupted QUICwire delivery; receiver bins are not wire-rate limits. psCPU is lifetimeaverage and RSS allocator footprint, not causal CPU/memory attribution.
metadata.raw_preservation: All probe.json/probe.err/runtime logs/service.jsonl remain in each raw_directory; runneroutput and every projected sample preserved here. MPP phase-router context is derived from the already saved six-cell artifact without new load.
metadata.cleanup: Existingrunner stoppedownedproducts; originHTTP/echo/sink remain. No additionalcells/build/modelchanges. Finalrouter remains downloadprofileepoch7 and must be reset by any later run.
